title: The Little girl at the gate
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：little　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 little 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 the craftsman wrote of ① a little girl at the gate in the ledger, and everybody in the workshop said at once that it was ② less than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the craftsman, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the little ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the least girl at the gate anybody in the workshop had ever seen, or so the ledger for August 1948 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too little to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the apprentice who had come to help; the little ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tool at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a little act of kindness, and said that no apprentice in his right mind would call it ⑥ as little as the act of kindness they had once had in the old workshop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was little or not, and he said so.

By 1961 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something little, and nothing besides. The apprentice from the next workshop called the whole plan ⑧ quite little; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the little ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1964, for the whole place, she wrote of another little girl at the gate in the same ledger, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ less than anybody had expected. ⑩ The least act of kindness in the whole workshop, she said in 1966, was the one she could never quite name; the little ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 小（前置定语 a little girl at the gate：1954 年匠人在工料簿里记下的那件小的女孩）
B. adj. 小／微不足道（比较级 less than：文中两处，一处比门口的小女孩，一处比预想）
C. adj. 小／微不足道（最高级 the least：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 小（表语 too little to do：母亲觉得它太小，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 微不足道（前置定语 a little act of kindness：叔叔把整件事称作一桩微不足道的善意举动）
F. adj. 微不足道（同级比较 as little as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩一个微不足道的善意举动相比）
G. adj. 微不足道（后置定语 something little：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 微不足道（受程度副词修饰 quite little：那位学徒的评价）

items.q: a little girl at the gate
the least girl at the gate anybody
The least act of kindness in

answers.why: little 意为“小”，1954 年匠人在工料簿里记下的是“一件小的女孩”，此处作前置定语 a little girl at the gate。
little 意为“小”，此处用比较级 less than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
little 意为“小”，工料簿上 八月 那行字说它是工坊里最小的一件，故用最高级 the least girl at the gate。
little 意为“小”，母亲认为这件东西“太小了，谁也用不上”，too little to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
little 意为“微不足道”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩微不足道的善意举动”，此处作前置定语 a little act of kindness。
little 意为“微不足道”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩一个微不足道的善意举动一样微不足道”，同级比较用 as little as。
little 意为“微不足道”，工料簿上那半行字要的是“微不足道的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something little。
little 意为“微不足道”，邻工坊来的那位学徒认为这套计划“相当微不足道”，quite 修饰原级 little。
little 意为“微不足道”，1964 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要微不足道”，故用比较级 less than。
little 意为“微不足道”，母亲 1966 年说的是“整个工坊里最微不足道的那一桩”，故用最高级 the least act of kindness。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1954 年，匠人在工料簿里记下了一件小的女孩。（a little girl at the gate）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更小。（less than …）
母亲觉得它太小，谁也用不上。（too little to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩微不足道的善意举动。（a little act of kindness）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩一个微不足道的善意举动一样微不足道。（as little as …）
到了 1961 年，工料簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件微不足道的东西。（something little）
answers: In 1954 the craftsman wrote of a little girl at the gate in the ledger.
Everybody said it was less than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too little to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a little act of kindness.
He said nobody would call it as little as the act of kindness they had once had.
By 1961 the ledger asked for nothing but something little.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 little 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1954 the craftsman wrote of a little girl at the gate in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the least girl at the gate in the workshop, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too little to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a little act of kindness, and nobody argued with him.
The apprentice from the next workshop called the plan quite little, and everybody laughed.
The little ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
